item.title: vCAC 6.0/6.1 build out to distributed model: Deploy the Identity Appliance
item.description: SSO is a fundamental requirement when deploying vCAC, whether for a distributed or simple installation. This walk through goes through the deployment and configuration of the vCAC Identity Appliance, which provides a stand alone SSO instance for vCAC.
